why.title: Why live teaching at Zarabicschool?
why.subtitle: Quran and Arabic cannot be mastered by passive watching alone. Our system is built on live reception, correcting pronunciation in the moment, and continuous student engagement.
why.live1Text: the teacher sees lip and tongue movement and corrects hidden and obvious mistakes on the spot.
why.live2Text: a weekly commitment prevents the procrastination typical of recorded courses.
why.live3Text: the teacher slows down or speeds up according to the student's comprehension, leaving nothing ambiguous.
why.live4Text: homework mistakes are discussed and remedied directly at the start of every lesson.
why.recorded1Text: a student may repeat a verse or rule incorrectly and it becomes entrenched unnoticed.
why.recorded2Text: the absence of human presence and mutual follow-up causes motivation to fade within weeks.
why.recorded3Text: the course is designed for a general audience and ignores individual differences and each child's goals.
why.recorded4Text: the guardian cannot know whether the student truly absorbed the material or merely watched.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about studying at Zarabicschool
faq.subtitle: Direct, practical answers about session organization, technical requirements, and absence & replacement policies.
faq.q1: How do I join a session, and which apps are required?
faq.a1: All live sessions are held via Zoom with secure links. All a student needs is a computer or tablet with a stable internet connection and a headset with a microphone to ensure clear pronunciation. The student and guardian receive the join link and reminder right before the lesson via the dashboard and alert messages.
faq.q2: What is the policy for rescheduling or excusing absence from a session?
faq.a2: We respect families' emergencies: an absence or change request can be submitted through the portal, and the academic supervisor coordinates with the teacher to arrange a replacement session to keep progress on track.
faq.q3: How is homework assigned and corrected?
faq.a3: At the end of every session the teacher records the assignment in the session report's homework section, where the guardian can review it via the portal. The teacher reviews completion and discusses notes at the start of the next session.
faq.q4: Can we change teachers if there is no educational fit with the student?
faq.a4: Absolutely. Your comfort and your child's engagement are our top priority. If the guardian or student feels a lack of rapport, contact the academic supervision directly and the student will be moved to another teacher with the full progress record transferred.
faq.q5: How do payments work, and which currencies are available?
faq.a5: We provide secure electronic payment in Egyptian pounds (EGP) plus an international gateway in US dollars (USD) serving our students around the world.
